title: Automate onboarding: aurora-xl-65b v1.0 perf/metadata + changelog generation
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR adds onboarding artifacts for aurora-xl-65b v1.0: model metadata, performance profiles for commonly used sequence lengths, and an automated changelog/release-notes entry generator that runs as part of the model-registry CI. Motivation: reduce manual steps when publishing new large models and ensure perf profiles + changelogs are consistently generated and validated. Changes include: (1) model metadata JSON and manifest with architecture/params/tokenizer/quantization recommendations; (2) perf profiles for 128/512/1024 seq lengths with summary latency/p90/p99 and throughput targets; (3) a GitHub Actions workflow step that runs perf profile validations and emits a changelog fragment to _changelogs/ which is auto-merged into the release notes via our changelog-bot; (4) small helper scripts to canonicalize model IDs and bump registry index. Checklist: - [x] metadata schema validated; - [x] perf profile CI checks implemented; - [x] changelog fragment generation added; - [x] docs entry and examples updated. Related: ENG-1742 for onboarding flow improvements, PM-83 for release notes automation. Testing: synthetic perf runs on perf-canary and unit tests for metadata schema. This description intentionally kept as a single continuous string to match PR export format.
